untested.faithfulness/context_precision/context_r: Requires an LLM judge; no judge backend was configured or called.
untested.tool_call_f1/trajectory_match/parallel_t: No unique reference tool-call route or parallel-call ground truth in these traces.
untested.wrong_version_rate/freshness/acl_complia: Required versions, dates, permission policies, conversational anchors or typed numeric labels are absent. The citation scorer's default wrong_version_rate=0 is not reported as a measured temporal result.
untested.security/toxicity/bias/guard/pairwise/pe: Require their own tasks, labels, models, comparisons or logits; not inferred from RAG traces.

notes: All 938 original episodes are audited; the separate scorer-v2 benchmark excludes 11 and retains 927.
Citation support checks existence/current-version of mapped document spans, not semantic entailment. These traces have document ids, so spans cover the visible prefix (800 characters maximum).
RGB alternative positives are OR evidence sets; historical benchmark scores are preserved.
This diagnostic uses recorded-v2; compare other models only after rescoring their traces with the same adapter.
Lexical scores are token-overlap diagnostics, not LLM-judged faithfulness. Answer scores use the canonical answer, not alias matching.
First-search ranking is measured only for answerable episodes with a search; supplied context and later searches are excluded from that ranked list.
Abstention accuracy is measured on valid final actions; invalid actions are counted separately.
Precomputed scoring latency is not model inference latency; no fresh inference performance claim is made.

rank_scope: four adapter families; published per-model scorer-v2 populations; no global rank or paired significance claim

hosted_model_comparison.scope: round-5 scorer-v2 shared intersection, all compared actors

assumptions: GPU-only busy time; excludes CPU, RAM, loading, startup, scoring overhead, storage, network and failed jobs
Verifier includes all 560 recorded cases, including deterministic rejects
Amortized batch throughput; not request latency or a cloud invoice
Historical T4 and hosted costs retain the README serving and token/cache assumptions

publication_notes: Numerical source data retained; machine-specific absolute training/checkpoint paths omitted or made relative
No new inference, semantic judge call or training run
DoRA not ranked in the 863-episode hosted-model comparison
No new custom metric or composite quality score
